items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: Mom and Darius and Michael were with Dave on that famous Middle Eastern tour.

ctx.x: He was born in a different country though. We all know that.

No, but I mean he didn’t come from a classic mother-father “Leave it to Beaver” background. It’s like just that that potential is all there. And I just wrote a piece that Dan and Darius played on their premier called “Mary Magdalene and the Garden Dweller” and I was hired specifically to write a piece in the style of Dave with jazz and also chorus and orchestra. And one of the things that amazes me is if you look at how nuns don’t have the powers of priests, and you know the church has always been so patriarchal.…
